module: Brush management for the Dynamic Decals tool: a preset saves the current state of the decal properties (color/alpha/metallic/normal/roughness textures, color, gradient, rotation, scale, skew, UV, alpha mask, SDF, mirror, intensities, wrap...). Brushes are stored in /art/dynamicDecals/brushes/brushes.json, listed in the browser's "Brushes" tab (order 30) and inspectable (Use / Delete / Save). A modder uses it to save or reload a decal setting.
notes: The brushes.json file is read at setup if it exists, otherwise the list is empty (no file is created before the first save).
saveBrush without a name uses the file name (without extension) of the current color texture. Each call adds a new entry, without a duplicate check.
The SDF properties (sdfThickness, sdfSoftness, sdfOutline*) are only saved if the color texture is SDF-compatible (decal.isTexturesSdfCompatible).

loadBrush applies each property via getValueOrDefault, which falls back to the default value of api.propertiesMap for a missing value. The alphaMaskInvert and decalUseGradientColor lines are commented out: these two saved properties are not restored on load (and the presumed setters do not exist under that name).
deleteBrush sets the id field of all brushes to nil before writing the file.

saveBrush.desc: Creates a brush from the current API state (api.get*), adds it to the list and writes brushes.json.

name.desc: Brush name; defaults to the color texture name.

loadBrush.desc: Applies to the API (api.set*) all properties of a brush: alpha mask, blend mode, color, textures, rotation, scale, skew, gradient, UV, SDF, etc.

brush.desc: Brush (brushes.json entry, see saveBrush for the fields).

inspectorGui.desc: Draws the inspector of a selected brush: Use (loadBrush), Delete and Save buttons (visible only if brush.dirty), then the preview and the properties.

getBrushes.desc: Returns the list of brushes loaded in memory.

returns.desc: List of brushes (the internal table, not a copy).

editorPreferenceValueChanged.desc: Hook called when a preference changes. Does nothing here.

setup.desc: Called by the tool: gets API, browser, selection and layerTypes_decal, loads brushes.json if present, registers the "Brushes" tab of the browser.
